assign.request: Reviewer minion for /imagine/vary/: ten-second test, primary interaction, layout at 3440, resolve findings in-realm, land.

log.msg: Ten-second test (before fix), 1280 shot: stranger sentence — four cards labelled Scroll, Tone, Place, Colstyles under a sentence that says "Three labs" — the count in the page's own words contradicts what is on screen, so a stranger's first reaction is to wonder whether a card is missing or mislabelled, not to grasp the point. Meant sentence (readme.md + doc/columns.md link): four small labs, each a tree of column-page variations under one question, browsed live as real linkable pages, not config options. Matches paging/critique's vary row exactly: 31% wide, 2180px dead, depth 6, four lab cards stacked 2x2 in a narrow default-width column, alt = "Tile wall, wide", score 61. Alternate was NOT applied before this task.

Primary interaction verified via ui-test drive.mjs (scratchpad vary-plan.json, vary-click/steps.json): probed .page-previews DOM first (vary-probe.mjs) and confirmed the hidden /imagine/ hub's own "Start" wall renders zero-size cards for every top-level realm alongside Vary's own four real cards (Scroll/Tone/Place/Colstyles, non-zero rects) - the "two of every selector" trap named in the brief, avoided by clicking the resolved href selector instead of text=. Clicking the Scroll card (the first thing a reader would see, top-left) opens a new column to the right titled "Scroll", crumb becomes Imagine > Vary > Scroll, and its own takeaway sentence plus three sub-cards (Full-viewport, Padded inset, Flush bleed) appear - label matches destination exactly. Zero console errors.

Fix 1 (highest-value, the stranger/meant mismatch): page.js's takeaway sentence said "Three labs" and its `description:` named only three concepts (scrollbars, background hierarchy, child placement) while `children:` has always listed four ("scroll tone place colstyles") and all four render on screen - colstyles was added after the copy was last written and the count/description were never updated. Rewrote both to "Four labs" / "Four variation trees - scrollbars, background hierarchy, child placement, column looks." readme.md already said "Four trees" correctly, so no change needed there - it was only page.js's own copy that had drifted. Caveat: I did not rename or reorder anything, only corrected the count and added the missing fourth concept to the description; undo by reverting page.js if a future 5th lab makes "Four" wrong again before the copy is touched.

Fix 2 (layout, matches paging/critique's vary row exactly - 31% wide, 2180px dead, depth 6, alt "Tile wall, wide", score 61): page.js now sets width:"large" and passes --column:"15em" to this.previews(), same pattern gallery/page.js already landed and documented for the identical problem tonight. NOT width:"full" - an earlier reviewer in this same wave measured that full collapses /imagine/'s own hub rail for as long as you stay inside the realm (gallery's finding, doc/decisions.md there); verified live here too (before/after 3440 shots, scratchpad vary-before-3440.png / vary-after-3440.png): with large, the hub rail (Imagine/Team/Design/.../Generated) stays on screen next to Vary's own now-single-row wall of four cards. At 3440 this took the landing page from 4 cards stacked 2x2 in a ~42em column to all 4 in one row inside large's ~64em ceiling - real but not total; large's own ceiling still leaves visible gray to the right at 3440 (previously 2180px dead, now roughly 1880px), which is the tradeoff large makes everywhere on the site to avoid full's rail-collapse bug. Caveat: undo (drop width:"large" and the --column override) if a 5th lab ever gets added and no longer fits one row at 3440, or if core ships a "wide-but-does-not-collapse-ancestors" word that fits better than large's fixed ceiling.

Swept all 21 pages in the realm (vary-sweep.mjs): index + 3 scroll variations + 5 tone variations + 3 place variations + 5 colstyles looks, all load with HTTP 200 and zero console errors, both before and after the page.js fix (colstyles.css, tone.css, scroll.css, place.css untouched - the four labs themselves were already clear, each with a plain takeaway sentence and a one-line verdict; the defect was only in the parent index's own copy and width, both now fixed). No other findings inside my fence: every leaf page has a working takeaway sentence, a real verdict, and correct navigation (add/swap/carousel all label their own placement behavior accurately and match it). No proposal needed upstream - nothing found here needs a core/ext change.

assign.outcome:
**Vary's landing page said "Three labs" while showing four — the count in its own words contradicted the four cards on screen. Fixed the copy and the width; the ten-second test now passes.**

- Fixed `page.js`: takeaway sentence and `description:` corrected from "Three labs" / three concepts to "Four labs" / four concepts (scrollbars, background hierarchy, child placement, column looks) — `colstyles` was added to `children:` after the copy was last written and never folded back in. `readme.md` already said "Four" correctly; only `page.js`'s own copy had drifted.
- Fixed `page.js` layout: `width: "large"` + `--column: "15em"` on `previews()`, matching `paging/critique`'s vary row exactly (31% wide, 2180px dead, depth 6, alt "Tile wall, wide", score 61) and the same pattern `gallery/page.js` landed earlier tonight for the identical problem. NOT `width: "full"` — an earlier reviewer this wave found `full` collapses `/imagine/`'s hub rail; verified live here too, before and after, that the rail survives with `large`. At 3440 this takes the four lab cards from stacked 2×2 in a ~42em column to one row inside `large`'s ~64em ceiling.
- Verified the primary interaction end to end (`ui-test` `drive.mjs`): clicking the Scroll card (first thing a reader sees) opens a new column, crumb becomes Imagine › Vary › Scroll, label matches destination exactly.
- Swept all 21 pages in the realm: zero console errors, all HTTP 200, both before and after. No other findings — every leaf page (scroll/tone/place/colstyles and their variations) already had a clear takeaway sentence and a real one-line verdict; nothing needed a core/ext proposal.

![Vary, fixed](/framework/ai/2026-09-04/imagine-review/shots/vary.jpg)

Caveats are per-fix in the log: the width fix trades some dead space for hub-rail survival (the site-wide `large`-vs-`full` tradeoff, not specific to this realm); the copy fix assumes "Four" stays right until a fifth lab is added.
